s: [s] klI, (vahati unatti vA । vaha prApaRe unda kledane vA + asun .) UDaH । ityamarawIkAyAM ramAnATaH ॥ garura pAlAn iti BAzA ॥

m: उधन् n. = ऊधन्, an udder, MaitrS. i, 3, 26
1. उध्रस् cl. 9. P. उध्रस्नाति, उध्रसां-बभूव or -चकार or -आस, औध्रासीत्, to gather, glean, Dhātup.; Vop.
2. उध्रस् cl. 10. P. Ā. उध्रासयति, -ते aor. औदिध्रसत्, -त, to glean; to throw or cast upwards, Dhātup.; Vop.
a: उध्रस् — {c9c} {c10c} P. (उध्रस्नाति, उध्रासयति) 1 To glean or gather little by little at a time. --2 To throw or cast upwards.

s: ga uYCe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (krAdiM-paraMsakaM-sew .) etasyAdO paYcamasvaraH । maDye kevalaDakArasyADo rePaH । kryAdAvuDrasa uYCa ityayamudiccOrAdikaH pawyate tasya DrAsayatIti rUpaM aparaM DrasnAti । yezAM DraseH utpUrvvasya gaRadvaye'pi paWanaM tezAM mate SnAviDAvuDrasnAti nigadyate Rici kfte'pyuDrAsayatyanyataH । atra utpUrvvasyeti tu ut ukAraH natUpasargaH । ga uDrasnAti SasyaM dInaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ka utkzepe । uYCe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAM-paraM-sakaM-sew .) ka uDrAsayati DUliM vAyuH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: uYCe kyrA॰ para॰ aka॰ sew । uDrasnAti ODrAsIt uDrasAm--baBUva Asa cakAra ।
utkzepe uYCe ca (kaRaSaAdAne) cu॰ saka॰ sew । uDrasayati te । OdiDrasat ta
